description: Cross-language vector for the wire version a session is negotiated at (Section 12.1.7). A SessionInit proposes a protocol_version and the SessionAck that answers it must state the same one; the session runs at that version, and every live act is signed and verified under it. Each case sets protocol_version on a SessionInit and a SessionAck as it says, removing the member when the case omits it, and both suites pass the pair to the session manager's create_session, which must accept it and run at runs_at, or refuse it with error_code and error_message. Nothing is filled in from the other message or from an implementation's own version. The cases whose SessionInit states the current version are also run through the initiator's client, which receives the SessionAck and must reach the same verdict before it signs anything.
